q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Li Ming. I’m twelve years old. I live in Beijing, in China. I usually go to school by bus, but sometimes my dad drives me. I take my books, my pencil case and a bottle of water. My favourite teacher is Miss Wang. She teaches English. She’s very kind and her lessons are always fun, because we play games and sing songs. At parties I usually eat pizza and cake, and I drink orange juice. I usually go to parties with my best friends from school.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如怎么去上学、最喜欢的老师教什么科目、为什么喜欢他/她、在派对上吃什么），用一般现在时说习惯，句子简单正确、前后连贯。

q2.sampleAnswer: I think swimming in a pool is nice, especially in summer, because the water is cool. Walking in the mountains is healthy, because you get lots of fresh air, but it’s tiring. I think dance classes are hard, because you must remember all the steps. Cycling is a good idea, because it’s fun and you can go to lots of places. I don’t think exercising on a running machine is fun. It’s boring, because you stay in the same place. I like cycling best. I prefer doing exercise with other people, because we can talk and help each other. No, I don’t enjoy doing exercise in the mornings, because I’m always tired. I prefer the afternoons.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图中的运动（在泳池游泳、爬山徒步、跳舞课、骑自行车、在跑步机上跑步）说出喜不喜欢以及原因，回应同伴的提问，回答考官的追问，说出最喜欢哪种运动，并能谈喜欢一个人还是和别人一起运动、喜不喜欢早上运动，用 because、but 等把理由说清楚。
